title: Project Virgil Playbook Frontmatter Schema
description: Validation schema for YAML frontmatter in Project Virgil incident response playbooks.

id.description: Unique identifier for the playbook following standard naming conventions.

title.description: The human-readable title of the incident playbook.

platform.description: Primary platform, service, operating system, or ecosystem covered.

version.description: Semantic versioning string for the playbook document.

last_verified.description: ISO-8601 date string indicating when recovery steps and direct URLs were last tested.

severity_level.description: Threat blast radius and impact classification.

endpoints.description: Direct URLs to administrative and recovery settings, bypassing brittle UI menus.

indicators.description: Observed symptoms indicating active compromise or account takeover.

clean_environment_required.description: Whether an out-of-band/uninfected device is strictly required to execute recovery.

prerequisite_warning.description: Contextual warning detailing why certain environments (e.g. infostealer-infected hosts) are dangerous.
